description: Update the caption, schedule, or recycle plan of a scheduled post. Overwrites the supplied fields; a new time changes when the post publishes. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

payload.description: Replacement post content. `payload.media` accepts URL objects, objects with `media_id`, or bare media-library UUID strings owned by the selected workspace.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

offset_seconds.description: Seconds after the source publishes when this recycle fires.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_scheduled_post
title: Update Scheduled Post
